title: Statistical analysis of Inverse Entropy-regularized Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2512.06956v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Inverse reinforcement learning aims to infer the reward function that explains expert behavior observed through trajectories of state--action pairs. A long-standing difficulty in classical IRL is the non-uniqueness of the recovered reward: many reward functions can induce the same optimal policy, rendering the inverse problem ill-posed. In this paper, we develop a statistical framework for Inverse Entropy-regularized Reinforcement Learning that resolves this ambiguity by combining entropy regularization with a least-squares reconstruction of the reward from the soft Bellman residual. This combination yields a unique and well-defined so-called least-squares reward consistent with the expert policy. translated_title: 逆熵正则化强化学习的统计分析
translated_abstract: 逆强化学习旨在推断能够解释通过状态-动作对轨迹所观察到的专家行为的奖励函数。经典逆强化学习（IRL）中一个长期存在的难题是恢复出的奖励函数不唯一：许多奖励函数都可以诱导出相同的最优策略，从而使得该逆问题成为不适定问题。本文为逆熵正则化强化学习建立了一个统计框架，通过将熵正则化与基于软Bellman残差的奖励最小二乘重构相结合，解决了这一歧义性问题。这种结合产生了一个唯一且定义良好的所谓最小二乘奖励，该奖励与专家策略相一致。我们将专家演示建模为马尔可夫链，其平稳分布由未知的专家策略 $\pi^\star$ 定义，并通过在一类条件分布上采用惩罚最大似然方法来估计策略。
tldr: 本文提出了逆熵正则化强化学习的统计框架，通过熵正则化与软Bellman残差最小二乘奖励重构相结合，解决了经典逆强化学习中奖励函数不唯一导致的不适定问题，并基于惩罚最大似然方法对专家策略进行估计。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a statistical framework for inverse entropy-regularized reinforcement learning that resolves the long-standing non-uniqueness (ill-posedness) of classical IRL by combining entropy regularization with least-squares reward reconstruction from the soft Bellman residual, yielding a unique and well-defined reward and a penalized maximum-likelihood estimate of the expert policy.
